name: JEP 517 - HTTP/3 for the HTTP Client API
dscr: Update the HTTP Client API to support the HTTP/3 protocol, so that libraries and applications can interact with HTTP/3 servers with minimal code change.

name: JEP 522 - G1 GC: Improve Throughput by Reducing Synchronization
dscr: Improve latency and throughput by reducing the amount of synchronization required between application threads and GC threads

name: JEP 526 - Lazy Constants (Preview)
dscr: Lazy Constants offer an immutable data abstraction for performance and safety.
